name: A Tanka boat with a figure operating a lift net
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A figure in a Tanka boat holds a pole over the stern; suspended from the pole is a net held just out of the water. For a comparable drawing see E.1632-1928.
